entry_item.definition: n., adj. , and adv. Peace, quiet, calm, rest; leisure; pleasure; good health, well-being; easy, not difficult; peacefully, quietly.

example.definition: To live in peace, be in good condition, feel well or comfortable.
To greet; to salute in a prescribed manner; to inquire after .somebody's health.
To live peacefully, lead a life of leisure, enjoy peace and rest.
To. find or enjoy peace or rest; to find an easy way.
To live peacefully; to be well.
How do you do?. How are you?. .
Not easy, difficult; not well, not at ease.
For the mind to be at ease

entry_item.definition: Ruhe, Zufriedenheit
n. Rest, repose, satisfaction, quietness, ease, contentment
Well-to-do. Enjoyment of restful life
〔形〕安静的，平安无事的：~ тайван 安宁，平静；~ жимэр 平平安安的；мэнд ~ 平安无事；санаа ~ 放心，安心；амрыг эрэх 问好，问安；~ байна уу? 你好？近来可好？；~ сайн уу? 您好？
